## What changed

- Fixed: the Claude Code plugin's hooks treated a git repository named `lat.md` as a docs directory. A session rooted in a parent folder of such a repository could write index files all over it. The hooks now skip it.
- After skipping such a repository, the plugin no longer suggests running `lat init`, because that would also write into the repository. Projects with no `lat.md/` at all still get the suggestion.
- A project whose `lat.md/` docs folder is itself a git repository or submodule is now skipped by the plugin's hooks too.
- Fixed: generated directory indexes copied raw HTML from a document's title or summary. `<` and `>` are now escaped, so a stray `<!--` can no longer hide the rest of an index page.
- Removed placeholder index files that had been added to the shipped `plugins/` and `templates/` folders by mistake.
